The version coordinate should be used to reference a resource in a different version of the same component or a specific version of a different component. When entering a version coordinate in a resource ID, it should always be the first coordinate and end with an at sign (

). If the component coordinate is not specified, the current component will be used. If the component coordinate is specified without specifying a version coordinate, the latest version of that component will be chosen.
The component coordinate is the name of the component to which the target resource belongs. The component name is specified by the
file that defines the resource’s component version.
